turns.message: Hi! I'm at an intermediate fitness level and my goal is to improve my strength over the long term.
Create a 12-week training program with phases.

expected_behaviors: Divide the 12 weeks into distinct training phases with different goals
Explain the progression logic between each phase
Apply progressive overload within each phase through volume or intensity
Include planned deload or recovery periods to prevent overtraining
Tailor exercise selection and difficulty to an intermediate fitness level
